tasks.title: Announcement #64
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
tasks.transcript: Good morning class. I want to remind you that our midterm exams will take place next week. Make sure to review your notes and textbooks. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the announcement?

options.A: To invite students to a review session
options.B: To encourage students to ask questions
options.C: To inform students about exam content
options.D: To remind students about the midterm exams

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：这则公告的主要目的是什么？ 定位原文：I want to remind you that our midterm exams will take place next week. 选项分析： A. To invite students to a review session 邀请学生参加复习课。公告中未提及复习课，所以A选项错误。 B. To encourage students to ask questions 鼓励学生提问。公告中提到“如果有问题可以随时联系”，但这不是主要目的，主要目的是提醒考试，所以B选项错误。 C. To inform students about exam content 告知学生考试内容。公告中未提及具体的考试内容，所以C选项错误。 D. To remind students about the midterm exams 提醒学生期中考试。说话者明确说“想提醒大家期中考试将在下周进行”，所以D选项正确。

questions.stem: What does the speaker suggest students do?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：说话者建议学生做什么？ 定位原文：Make sure to review your notes and textbooks. 选项分析： A. Submit their assignments 提交作业。公告中未提及作业，所以A选项错误。 B. Visit the library 去图书馆。公告中未提及图书馆，所以B选项错误。 C. Review their notes and textbooks 复习笔记和课本。说话者明确说“一定要复习笔记和课本”，所以C选项正确。 D. Attend a study group 参加学习小组。公告中未提及学习小组，所以D选项错误。
